description:
Driven to the brink of ruin by crushing poverty and a devastating scam, Lee Dokyeong makes a desperate gamble. Alongside a friend, he breaks into an isolated, secluded house to steal whatever they can find. However, what awaits them inside the pitch-black mansion isn't hidden wealth, it is a gruesome trail of bloodstains and a cold, lifeless corpse.

Just as paralyzing terror takes hold, an unidentified entity named Ko Inwu emerges from the shadows. Wearing a flawless human disguise, this terrifying monster spares Dokyeong's life, only to force him into a twisted, coercive sexual encounter instead.

With his origins, identity, and true intentions completely shrouded in mystery, this otherworldly creature keeps Dokyeong ensnared. Desperate to survive, Dokyeong begins digging into Inwu's secrets, only to find himself sinking deeper into a bizarre, perilous reality where every truth is darker than the last.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/hiddencast)

**Official Translations:**  
[English](https://www.lezhinus.com/en/comic/hiddencast), [Spanish](https://www.lezhin.es/detail/hidden-cast), [Thai](https://www.lezhinth.com/detail/hidden_cast), [T.Chinese](https://www.bomtoon.tw/detail/hiddencast), [Japanese](https://www.beltoon.jp/detail/hidden_cast)

##### Note: This series is a global release, meaning all official translations come out on the same day as the original Korean. All official translations are uncensored, except for Japanese.
